speaker: Doctor
text: Welcome to the clinic, I am Dr. Agent. You mentioned experiencing intense itching and developing red bumps on your thigh and other parts of your body; can you tell me how long you have been having these symptoms and if they are itchy only at night?

speaker: Patient
text: 47-year-old male. The patient presents with intense itching of his right thigh region for the past few days. He also mentions the recent formation of ‘red bumps’ in the same area. The patient has recently attended a business conference in Miami. He has a past medical history of hypertension, diabetes type 2, and hyperlipidemia. The patient’s medication regimen includes enalapril, metformin, and atorvastatin. He denies any history of smoking or drinking.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Scabies.

The intense nocturnal itching, red bumps, and recent travel to Miami are highly suggestive of scabies. Can you confirm if anyone else in your household or close contacts has developed similar symptoms?
